integrity: Exact algebraic proof and reproducible finite-case checks; finite tests do not certify the infinite theorem.
limitations: Applies to the split unital radical-square-zero associative algebra; finite rank enumeration requires a finite field. The complex three-dimensional special case is known from arXiv:2308.12121. No claim of independent audit or of exhaustive novelty detection.
title: Complete finite-field Nijenhuis rank spectra of split square-zero local algebras
